sourceNote: ONLY the 16 approved species and six approved mixed-heritage entries. These heritages are not separate species.
raceBloodlinePolicy: Roster locked to Approved Race Canon 2026-10-11: 16 species, 6 mixed heritages. No D&D or legacy races may be generated or selected.

racesDetailed.name: Dril'thar
racesDetailed.description: Small to modestly sized amphibious people, usually about one to four feet tall, with sinewy limbs, damp protective skin, webbed hands and feet, and often a powerful prehensile tail. Sensory fins or frills can frame the head. Large reflective eyes, color-shifting patterns, and luminous markings permit both speech and visual expression. They can move upright or on four limbs; moisture is essential to their health.

bloodlines.name: Grassland
bloodlines.description: Light sky blue, pale tan or sun-washed gold surfaces adapted to open wet meadows. Legs remain strong for leaping and traversing shallow water.

bloodlines.name: Lush Forest
bloodlines.description: Moss green, bark brown and lichen gray coloring; fine rootlike patterns help bodies blend into shaded wet woodland.

bloodlines.name: Marsh
bloodlines.description: Peat brown, slate gray and murky green mottling, often with a denser protective skin coating for stagnant wetlands.

bloodlines.name: Rainforest
bloodlines.description: Vivid emerald, sapphire or violet skins carrying bright bioluminescent rainlike markings and pronounced sensory frills.

bloodlines.name: Ocean
bloodlines.description: Ocean lineages may be slightly larger, with elongated swimming profiles, reflective seafoam or deep blue skin, and strong tails.

bloodlines.name: Reef
bloodlines.description: Brilliant reds, turquoise, luminous pink and textured coral-like patterning; fins and webbing support reef-water movement.

racesDetailed.name: Kaluseban
racesDetailed.description: Tall, slender, graceful magic-dependent humanoids with features that vary markedly among bloodlines. Skin may range from pale ivory through earth green and brown to deep sapphire. Eyes glow faintly in the color of their affinity, while fine hair can shimmer or float in dense ambient magic. Appearance should communicate personal lineage, not a single uniform skin color.

bloodlines.name: Psionic
bloodlines.description: psionic light in the eyes or temple markings can be an individual appearance cue.

bloodlines.name: Swamp
bloodlines.description: Wetland greens and browns with reed-like markings are characteristic possible looks. The historic text describes woodland and marsh-linked ancestors, but not every detail of this current label.

bloodlines.name: Arcane
bloodlines.description: Luminous pale or violet skin and shifting magical markings are among the approved options for an arcane lineage.

bloodlines.name: Dark
bloodlines.description: Low-light, shadow-touched coloring and dim luminescence can occur in this bloodline.

bloodlines.name: Stone
bloodlines.description: Source describes granite, sandstone and muted moonstone coloration, crystalline highlights, and markings reminiscent of stone inscriptions.

bloodlines.name: Oceanic
bloodlines.description: Pearlescent aquamarine or tide-blue color and water-adapted accents are approved visual options.

racesDetailed.name: Azrahai
racesDetailed.description: Original Aza'ran draconic people whose living anatomy includes scales, a powerful tail, clawed hands, facial ridges and, where appropriate to lineage, wings. Bodies range from heavy mineral-armored to long and streamlined. Ancient records call these same people Azh’raim; their modern name is Azrahai.

bloodlines.name: Noitzideq
bloodlines.description: Tall with layered green or blue-green scales, gold and dark speckles, feather-edged aerodynamic wings, and a muscular tail.

bloodlines.name: Saelftum
bloodlines.description: Massive, volcanic-adapted build with charcoal or black scales, amber and red accents, broad wings, horns and molten-looking fissures.

bloodlines.name: Jazwed
bloodlines.description: Coarse red-green iridescent scales, crystal clusters, dense muscular frame and shorter gliding wings adapted to heat.

bloodlines.name: Khoalaros
bloodlines.description: Long aquatic body with dark reflective scales, bioluminescent veins, webbed extremities, dorsal fins and swimming-capable wings and tail.

bloodlines.name: Gauksneth
bloodlines.description: Pale sand-colored crystalline scales, slim limbs and long sail-like wings suited to arid terrain.

bloodlines.name: Tuorszom
bloodlines.description: Gray, brown and black layered scales with mineral streaks, protective plates, and broad climbing hands and feet.

bloodlines.name: Taudinax
bloodlines.description: Dark iridescent scales, semi-translucent patches, silent wings, elongated fingers and a flexible tail.

bloodlines.name: Gouxelq
bloodlines.description: Deep blue metallic scales, crystal protrusions on shoulders and knuckles, heavy frame and broad flight wings.

bloodlines.name: Vautaces
bloodlines.description: Smooth ruby-red and cream scales with radiant crystal edging, long fingers, elegant wings and fine facial ridges.

racesDetailed.name: Panolima
racesDetailed.description: People whose bodies visibly reflect one of five elemental affinities, rather than a separate generic Elementaris species. Some are solid as stone, some carry ember patterns, others appear fluid, airy or illuminated by magical energy. Their silhouettes and voices may change with the environment; none of those forms should be mistaken for a separate current species.

bloodlines.name: Earth
bloodlines.description: Bark or stone textured skin, mosslike hair, weighty build, earthy fissures and a deep resonant voice.

bloodlines.name: Fire
bloodlines.description: Glowing ember veins, heatlike shimmer and hair that can suggest flame; specific color and physiology vary.

bloodlines.name: Water
bloodlines.description: Fluid, reflective skin and flowing hair or limbs that resemble currents; water effects need not imply constant liquid anatomy.

bloodlines.name: Air
bloodlines.description: Light, wind-swept features and shifting translucency, with clothing or hair that seems moved by unseen breezes.

bloodlines.name: Aether
bloodlines.description: Luminous magical auras, irregular light patterns and other non-elemental arcane features.

racesDetailed.name: Jaspey
racesDetailed.description: Jaspey are recognized as one people with three established forms, Mosscap, Gloomtail, and Rotcap. Each form has identifiable surface markings or anatomy. Their shared underlying body plan is not specified in the surviving current reference, so no extra height, limb count, or facial anatomy is invented here.

bloodlines.name: Mosscap
bloodlines.description: A moss-textured head or crown, with soft green-brown highlights.

bloodlines.name: Gloomtail
bloodlines.description: A shadow-adapted tail or low-light markings.

bloodlines.name: Rotcap
bloodlines.description: Dark fungal or decay-associated patterning.

racesDetailed.name: Deorbasun
racesDetailed.description: Tall to towering magical shapeshifters, sometimes feline or beastlike, whose physiques vary from muscular to lithe. Fur, scales or earth-toned skin, reflective eyes, wings, tails or other animal features vary according to the individual's soul bond. No single default animal form applies to every member.

bloodlines.name: Open Soul-Animal
bloodlines.description: This is an open choice, not a preset wolf, cat or bird subtype. Record the person’s initial appearance and update markings or silhouette only after the true soul bond is established.

racesDetailed.name: Gandirosha
racesDetailed.description: Wiry or lithe agile figures, roughly three to six feet tall in the detailed source, with softly luminous skin and shifting freckle-like or sigil markings. Hair can range from honey and copper to chestnut, jade and gold. Eyes may glow subtly when magic is active; layered clothes and charms suit travel and performance.

racesDetailed.name: Gwynis
racesDetailed.description: Dream-born people with forms ranging from tall, shadow-touched silhouettes to luminous figures with weightless hair and shifting auroral features. Their eyes may appear to perceive several layers of reality. Intangibility and visual fluidity vary with magic and should not be assigned as a compulsory permanent body type.

racesDetailed.name: Geisamahi
racesDetailed.description: Small, upright, ferret- or stoatlike people with compact wiry bodies, elongated muzzles, expressive eyes, twitching whiskers and opposable thumbs. Fur may be brown, russet, orange, snow white or patterned. Their movement is nimble and acrobatic, and they often carry small belts and handmade tools.

racesDetailed.name: Tamhiogal
racesDetailed.description: Amphibious aquatic people with dramatic betta-fish coloration: brilliant blues, violets, teals, reds and shifting iridescence. On land they have scaled humanoid legs and arms, bioluminescent jellyfish-like hair, reflective eyes and scales at the face and neck. In water, gills, webbing, dorsal fins and a long caudal fin become prominent. They need hydration and tidal energy.

racesDetailed.name: Aburata
racesDetailed.description: Infernal magical beings with a humanoid and a quadrupedal equine-inspired form. Humanoid skin can resemble obsidian, molten iron or violet stone, marked by ember veins and living sigils. Curved or bladelike horns, fire-bright or voidlike eyes, varied hair and a prehensile tail distinguish individuals. The equine form adds a muscular horse-like trunk and hooved legs.

racesDetailed.name: Volsarii
racesDetailed.description: Ethereal four-armed people with elongated ear horns, sensitive antennae, iridescent skin and luminous or nebula-like eyes. Hair can look like liquid light, drifting mist or fine feathers. They pass through several lives in service to Nyxarion; during the final life they develop wings. No fixed number of lives is established.

racesDetailed.name: Zirramunis
racesDetailed.description: Compact, densely muscled humanoids with thick bones, strong forearms, calloused hands and skin ranging from granite gray and earth brown to ember-red. Their eyes shine in jewel-like shades. All genders may wear decorated beards, rings and braids as family or achievement records. The source does not name separate biological subtypes.

racesDetailed.name: Garuraqets
racesDetailed.description: Fine-boned, slender, magic-dependent winged people with iridescent skin in lilac, silver, mint and pale blue. Luminous hair may carry petals or glimmers. Their wings can resemble butterfly, dragonfly, leaves or living light; these are documented variations in wing morphology, not four separately approved species.

bloodlines.name: Butterfly-winged

bloodlines.name: Dragonfly-winged

bloodlines.name: Leafwoven-winged
bloodlines.description: Leaflike wing outlines and botanical texturing; source-documented morphology.

bloodlines.name: Bioluminescent-winged
bloodlines.description: Wings patterned with active light; source-documented morphology.

racesDetailed.name: Iamhazira
racesDetailed.description: Very tall, heavily muscled people built for endurance. Skin ranges from charcoal gray and ochre to muted green, with scars or war paint carrying personal histories. Tusks may bear rings or carvings. Eyes often resemble embers or dark steel, hair is thick and braided, and ears are elongated or battle-nicked. No current source supplies an approved biological bloodline list.

racesDetailed.name: Aza’raan
racesDetailed.description: Aza'raans are generally tall, slender and graceful, with long limbs and a very pale to slightly tanned complexion. The usual unmixed skin-color range resembles fair to lightly tanned complexions seen among Italian, Slavic and Balkan human populations, without implying any shared Earth ethnic identity. Copper, deep copper, auburn and dark auburn are the most common hair colors. Brown appears sometimes, while black and blonde are rare. Silver, blue and green eyes are common, often with a distinctly oceanic shape, occasionally dual-toned or subtly reflective. High oceanic-style cheekbones, a slightly angular brow with shallow paired ridges, and long ears swept backward are defining traits. Ear tips range from moderately pointed to dramatically sharp and elongated, with individual variation. Some Aza'raans bear faint freckles, subtle psionic luminescence, or wave-like ritual markings. Kaluseban, Deorbasun, Zirramunis, Iamhazira and Gandirosha ancestry can introduce additional color, stature, ear, hair, eye, animal-associated, or magical characteristics; such variation does not redefine the typical unmixed appearance.

racesDetailed.name: Kalus’aan
racesDetailed.description: Documented Aza’raan and Kaluseban mixed-ancestry community. Their Aza’raan cranial ridges, slender limbs, silver, blue, or green eyes and copper-to-auburn hair may mingle with Kaluseban color shifts, luminous marks, mineral textures, water-adapted accents, or forest and shadow features. The six documented Kalus’aan expressions are Arcane, Starborne, Wildroot, Tideborn, Stonebound, and Umbral; they are not six separate species. Appearance differs with the family and the particular Kaluseban bloodline.

racesDetailed.name: Kalusogal
racesDetailed.description: A documented Tamhiogal and Tideborn Kaluseban mixed community. Land forms retain smooth scaled cheeks and limbs, glowing eyes and kelplike bioluminescent hair. Aquatic forms show a streamlined tail fin, elbow and spine fins, and richly colored blue, crimson and violet scales. The two parental ancestries account for variation without requiring an invented separate bloodline list. This is Tamhiogal and Kaluseban ancestry, not an Aza’raan heritage or a separate founding species.

racesDetailed.name: Aza’zira
racesDetailed.description: Documented Aza’raan and Iamhazira mixed-ancestry community. Individuals blend Aza’raan facial proportions, psionic markings, and reflective eyes with Iamhazira height, powerful musculature, endurance traits, braids, strong jaw structure, and sometimes tusk features. Complexion may extend beyond the unmixed pale-to-lightly-tanned baseline where that parental lineage is visible. Individuals may retain copper or auburn hair, or express their Iamhazira family’s tones and scar or ornament customs.

racesDetailed.name: Aza’raan with Deorbasun ancestry
racesDetailed.description: An Aza’raan descendant of a Deorbasun family may keep pale-to-lightly-tanned Aza’raan skin and auburn or copper hair while expressing more pronounced reflective eyes, feline or other soul-animal hints, a heavier mane, unusual ear contours, tail, fur patches, claw-like nails, or rare wing features. The Deorbasun soul-animal bond is individually expressed and cannot be assigned a standard animal or fixed bloodline by appearance alone. No separate canonical community name has been established.

racesDetailed.name: Aza’raan with Zirramunis ancestry
racesDetailed.description: These descendants may be shorter or more densely built than a typical Aza’raan, with strong forearms, compact musculature, prominent bone structure, mineral-glinting eyes, stone-colored accent markings, and thick hair or beard growth. Copper and dark auburn hair and the silver, blue, or green Aza’raan eye spectrum can persist, with jeweled or metallic notes from Zirramunis heritage. No distinct mixed-species name or special fixed subtype is confirmed.

racesDetailed.name: Aza’raan with Gandirosha ancestry
racesDetailed.description: These descendants can retain the typical pale or lightly tanned Aza’raan complexion, copper or auburn hair and silver, blue, or green eyes, while expressing greater agility, a more compact or lithe build, freckles that resemble luminous sigils, more mobile facial expression, or colorful hair highlights associated with Gandirosha ancestry. These are variable family traits, not a separate named species or mandatory personality features.
